imageInspector.dragHint: Drag corners in the canvas to scale, rotate, or apply perspective distortion. Drag the area to move.

panelInspector.dragHint: Drag the area to move, individual points to reshape. Double-click the edge to add a point, right-click a point to remove it (at least 3 points remain). Editor marker only — does not appear in the PNG export.
panelInspector.languageOverrideHint: Position, shape, and content then only apply to this language — other languages (e.g. the Japanese original) keep showing the base version unchanged. Child bubbles are not affected.
panelInspector.removedHint: The content is only ever painted over at its original spot, never redrawn anywhere — the panel then counts as absent from scripts, reports, and reading order. Purely visual/semantic: geometry and child bubbles stay unchanged, reversible any time by switching back to "Original cut-out". Independent of the "Delete panel" button below, which permanently removes the record.
panelInspector.cutPanelHint: Cut-Panel: its content is detached from the original page. Moving it carries the content along; the vacated spot is covered with the fill color. Reshaping a corner adjusts the cut region.
panelInspector.activateCutAllLanguagesHint: Detaches the panel's content once for every language at once — the right choice when this panel's art (e.g. a finished panel drawing you're placing on a blank page) is the same regardless of language. Use the per-language option below instead for a language-specific exception.
panelInspector.activateCutHint: Detaches the panel's content from the original page for this one language — it can then be moved, removed, or replaced with your own image (see below). Other languages stay unchanged. Non-destructive: as long as "Content" is set to "Original cut-out", the panel looks unchanged.

exportPanel.title: Export
exportPanel.uniformHint: Every exported page is brought to this exact size. Pages whose aspect ratio deviates too much from it are flagged for review with a preview before anything is exported.
exportPanel.finalFormatPixelHint: → {{width}}×{{height}} px, margin {{margin}} px on every side. The artwork is scaled down (never up) to fit the space inside the margin, centered — never distorted.
exportPanel.finalFormatMarginTooLarge: The margin is too large for this page size — reduce it or enlarge the page.
exportPanel.formatPrintHint: 300dpi tag only, no resampling — a low-resolution scan stays low-resolution. Generic CMYK conversion, no custom print-shop ICC profile yet.
exportPanel.formatVectorPdfHint: Bubble text becomes real, selectable/copyable PDF vector text (not a pixel raster) — rect/oval/curved text exact, quad bubbles as an affine approximation (true perspective is technically impossible in the PDF format itself). Vertical (tategaki) text is a later phase. Without a configured ICC profile, the file isn't a certified PDF/X (see the report after export).
exportPanel.formatPsdHint: Exports a layered Photoshop file: background / retouches-cut-panels-images / one layer per bubble and curved-text element. Every layer is a raster image you can hide/move/mask.
exportPanel.psdEditableTextLayersHint: Also attaches a real, Type-tool-editable text object to bubbles that support it (plain rectangle/oval, horizontal, solid color, not merged) — everything else stays a raster image, as always. Such a bubble becomes two layers ("… (Background)" / "… (Text)") since a Photoshop text layer can't also carry the bubble's outline/fill. Photoshop shows an "Update" prompt the first time you open the file; click Update to make the text editable.
